pricing.details: Free — 3 AI-generated presentations per month and 3 template downloads per month. Premium 4.99 €/month, or 2.50 €/month billed 29.99 € annually (“save 50% with a yearly plan”), cancel anytime — AI-generated presentations and template downloads described as Unlimited, with an official footnote that Premium users have a security cap of 150 AI generations per month and 150 downloads per month. Access to the full library of 30,000+ templates, Slidesclass, early access to new AI presentation features, invite and manage team members, ad-free, no attribution required. VAT and local taxes may apply. Bigger discounts from 3 users; special prices for schools, districts and universities on request. Official prices already in euro, shown as published. “Unlimited” is officially capped at 150/month.
